description.en: The ID of the caption template.

description.zh: 字幕模板名称，仅支持数字、大小写字母或短横线-，短横线不和位于首位。
description.en: The name of the caption template. The name can contain only digits, letters, and hyphens (-). A hyphen cannot be the first character.

descriptions.zh:
本接口支持删除直播指定的字幕模板。

><notice>当前实时字幕功能处于邀测阶段，单个用户最多可添加300个字幕模板。
></notice>

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为60次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to delete a specified caption template for a live stream.

><notice>

The real-time caption feature is in invitational preview. Each user can add up to 300 caption templates.

></notice>

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 60 calls per second for each user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-ai-subtitle --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subtitle-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --subtitle-name sub01 --region cn-hangzhou
